# Where the workflow.md repair lands, and why it is slice 4 and not now

Ruud's decision, taken at the slice 1 boundary: the regression SEEN-139's docs
regeneration left in `docs/harness/workflow.md` is repaired inside SEEN-114
rather than in a separate pull request to main.

It lands in slice 4, which already names `docs/harness/workflow.md` in its file
list, as its own commit with its own message. Three reasons for the timing rather
than doing it in the next ten minutes:

**It cannot unblock main from here.** Fixing the document on this branch makes
this branch's CI green and leaves main red until this ticket merges. The two open
pull requests, SEEN-110 and SEEN-112, stay red either way. So the only thing the
repair has to unblock is this ticket's own `verify-delivery`, and that is at the
end.

**Slice 2 does not name the file, and the guard is right to refuse it.** Doing it
now would mean either a second `return` to solution to widen slice 2's file list,
which buys nothing the ordering does not already buy, or writing the file through
a shell to get around the PreToolUse guard, which is the one thing a guard exists
to stop. Slice 4 names the file because it documents `rule_candidate` and the
doctor warning there; the repair is the same file in the same slice.

**The restore is a merge, not a revert.** SEEN-139's commit both reverted ten
paragraphs and added content that must stay: the correctness programme section
this ticket belongs to, Sprint 8, epic E11 and the ticket counts. So the repair
takes the current file and restores the ten paragraphs from cf604d9 one at a
time, and the two table rows with them. That is careful work, and it is better
done in the slice whose other business is the same document than wedged between
two ast-grep rules.

What slice 4 must restore, from `git show cf604d9:docs/harness/workflow.md`:
the five paragraphs of the context-per-session section (the delegation, what a
subagent costs, the forecast, the hooks), the review triage and the route, the
shadow rule, what Jev is and is not, the Outcome convention, the two open
questions, and the Hooks and Permissions rows of the assistants table. The
assertion that must pass is
`harness.tests.test_triage.PartlySettledIsDocumentedTest`, which asks for every
name in `triage.PARTLY_SETTLED`; passing it is necessary and not sufficient, and
the test to run after is the whole harness suite.
